title: Choose the right specialist before acting
prompt: In at most two short lines and without editing any file: when a task names a domain, how should you decide which specialist to use before you start?
rubric: The reply says to consult the routing index (or roster) to rank candidates before acting.
It says to validate the chosen name rather than guess one.
acceptance: The model states that it selects a specialist by routing the task through the index and validating the name before starting.
